findings.quoted_text: Minor clarifications may be made through ordinary project communications, provided that such clarification does not materially increase the workload.
Minor clarifications may be made through ordinary project communications, provided that such clarification does not materially increase the workload.
findings.explanation: The clause lets the client request minor clarifications without a formal change order, but it is vague about what constitutes a material increase, so you could be asked to do extra work without additional pay.
findings.suggested_change: Any clarification or addition to the Services that results in additional work shall be documented in a written change order and shall be compensated at the rates set forth in the Agreement.
